trap.label: let x be
trap.wrong: Let x is a point on the line.
trap.right: Let x be a point on the line.
trap.why: Em português “seja x um ponto” usa subjuntivo e o aluno põe is. Em inglês, depois de Let X use be.

fix.wrong: Suppose that the line is finite, then we gets a segment.
fix.right: Suppose that the line is finite; then we get a segment.

fix.wrong: Choose a point at the chosen circle.
fix.right: Choose a point on the chosen circle.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Suppose: “Assume the line is finite.”
rewrite.answer: Suppose that the line is finite.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Then: “From the assumption we get a segment.” (Then…)
